# Parivāra-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Vin02a4)
**ID:** Atk Vin02a4
**Section:** Aṭṭhakathā Vinayapiṭake (Dutiyo bhāgo) (atk-vin02)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Vinaya

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Parivāra-aṭṭhakathā* is the commentary on the *Parivāra*, cataloged as part of the second section of the Vinaya commentary (*Aṭṭhakathā Vinayapiṭake (Dutiyo bhāgo)*). In biographical tradition, it is cited under the title *Vinayaparivāra-aṭṭhakathā* as a work of Buddhaghosa, recording that he studied the ancient Sinhalese commentarial traditions—the *Mahā-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Mahāpaccari-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Kurundi-aṭṭhakathā*—under the teacher Buddhamitta prior to composing his treatises [Gray 1892].
Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal alignment, showing 20,620 matching passages shared across 287 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial reuse partners are later Vinaya subcommentaries and digests, particularly the *Vinayavinicchaya-ṭīkā* (1,002 matches), the *Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā* (791 matches), the *Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi*, the *Pācityādiyojanā*, the *Vinayālaṅkāra-ṭīkā*, the *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā*, the *Vajirabuddhi-ṭīkā*, the *Vimativinodanī-ṭīkā*, and the *Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. It also shares significant parallel text with other sections of the Vinaya commentary, such as the *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as canonical Vinaya portions including the *Samathakkhandhaka* (Kd 14) and sections of the canonical *Parivāra* itself (such as the *Ekuttarikanaya* and *Upālipañcaka*) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language parallels with score ≥10 are reported in DharmaNexus [DharmaNexus].
